name: Presumption of Innocence
description: A defendant is presumed innocent until the prosecution establishes the required elements of an offense according to the applicable standard.

name: Burden of Proof
description: The prosecution carries the burden of establishing the required elements of the charged offense.

name: Evidence Requirement
description: A claim cannot be treated as an established fact solely because an agent states it.

name: Reasonable Doubt
description: If substantial uncertainty remains regarding an essential element of the offense, the defendant should not be convicted.

name: Evidence Consistency
description: Contradictory evidence must be explicitly identified and considered.
